Noah B.: FYI ran into a funky onboarding repro: python SDK paginators + prefetch cause repeated 429s even when server sends `Retry-After`. seems like global backoff timer is being clobbered by concurrent workers.
Ivy C.: can you drop the run command + a short log?
Noah B.: run: `python examples/onboard_prefetch.py --workers 5 --prefetch 3 --mode embed+paginate` then hit a dataset (~8k rows). log snippet: ```2024-06-11T09:42:18Z WARN request 429 route=/v1/embeds Retry-After=3s worker=2
2024-06-11T09:42:18Z INFO global_backoff start backoff_until=2024-06-11T09:42:21Z
2024-06-11T09:42:20Z ERROR request 429 route=/v1/embeds Retry-After=3s worker=4
2024-06-11T09:42:21Z INFO global_backoff cleared
2024-06-11T09:42:21Z ERROR request 429 route=/v1/embeds Retry-After=3s worker=1```
Marcus D.: hmmm looks like workers ignore the per-response Retry-After and then trigger manual global backoff which clears too early. can you repro with `--debug-backoff`?
Noah B.: yeah reproduces. with debug on i can see: worker sees Retry-After=3, writes to shared backoff state `backoff_until = now + 3s`, but other workers are racing and overwrite with smaller values or clear when their local timers expire. result = repeated bursts every ~3s.
Evelyn R.: that explains why prefetch amplifies it: prefetch grabs N pages ahead, so when one worker hits 429 it manifests across many in-flight requests.
Ivy C.: quick mitigation: sample app patch to honor per-response Retry-After per worker (local backoff) and reduce prefetch from 3 -> 1. did you try that?
Noah B.: yes patched sample to `prefetch=1` and `worker_backoff=True` and things smoothed out for 50k rows. also added a tiny randomized jitter when clearing backoff: `clear += rand(0, 150ms)` to avoid exact alignment.
Marcus D.: long-term fix for SDK: don't use a single mutable backoff timestamp across workers. model semantics: prefer per-worker gate that respects server Retry-After, plus optional global circuit-breaker that triggers only if >X 429s across workers in Y window. also ensure prefetch reservation prevents a worker from occupying >M tokens for multi-page requests.
Evelyn R.: agree. also add test in devex harness: run 5 workers + prefetch=3 against mock endpoint returning Retry-After=2 and ensure no >3 429s in any 5s window.
Ivy C.: i'll file an issue and a PR skeleton for py-sdk. Noah can you attach the repro script + logs under `examples/onboard/prefetch-retry-after`?
Noah B.: done. pushed simple fix to sample app and opened issue: py-sdk/#429-retry-after-race. tagging @Marcus D. for SDK change.
ops-bot: ci queued: examples/onboard -> staging (build 11902) :rocket:
Marcus D.: thanks everyone. small docs note: "Python SDK: when using prefetch or high worker counts, reduce prefetch and ensure SDK version >= 0.12.3 which contains backoff-race fixes." i'll add compatibility tests and a short blurb in onboarding guide.
